001package dev.nandi0813.api.Interface;
002
003import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
004
005/**
006 * A bot body spawned by a {@link BotProvider} for one round.
007 * The core calls every method on the main thread.
008 */
009public interface BotOpponent {
010
011    /**
012     * The live body. Its UUID equals the entity id passed to {@link BotProvider#spawn}.
013     * @return The body, never null
014     */
015    Player getPlayer();
016
017    /**
018     * Run one tick of bot behavior. Called once per server tick during the start countdown and while the round is live (see {@link BotFightView#isLive()}), and never otherwise.
019     * Throwing an exception ends the match.
020     * @param view The current round state
021     */
022    void tick(BotFightView view);
023
024    /**
025     * Stop all inputs and item use, keeping the current momentum.
026     * Called at round end and after a death.
027     */
028    void pause();
029
030    /**
031     * Run one tick of physics with no input while the bot is not fighting (round end).
032     * Called once per server tick instead of {@link #tick(BotFightView)}. Defaults to {@link #pause()}.
033     */
034    default void idle() {
035        pause();
036    }
037
038    /**
039     * Show the body to a fighter or spectator.
040     * @param viewer The viewer
041     */
042    void show(Player viewer);
043
044    /**
045     * Hide the body from a viewer. Also called for viewers who went offline.
046     * @param viewer The viewer
047     */
048    void hide(Player viewer);
049
050    /**
051     * Remove the body. Called when the round or match ends; must be safe to call more than once.
052     */
053    void remove();
054
055}
